description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for managing the physical deletion of 'thing' entities marked as deleted within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods to check if deletion is enabled, and to retrieve parameters such as deletion age, run interval, and first run hour. It also contains an internal enum for known configuration paths and default values.

classes.name: DeletionConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration options related to the physical deletion of entities marked as deleted.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether physical deletion of marked entities is enabled.

methods.name: getDeletionAge
methods.description: Returns the duration after which entities are eligible for deletion.

methods.name: getRunInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval at which deletion runs are scheduled.

methods.name: getFirstIntervalHour
methods.description: Returns the hour of the day (UTC) when the first deletion run should occur.
